reuse.why: Adds one helper used by all five link functions and keeps using link.findOrCreateBank; there was no existing duplicate-link helper to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only the guard call itself is repeated in each provider function, which follows from the tree having no shared link path.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts next to its callers; accounts/link.ts, which already holds the linking helper findOrCreateBank, would have been a slightly better home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, named and easy to follow; syncSource is typed as a plain string instead of the sync-source type, and a future provider must remember to add the call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; all five link functions call the new assertBankAccountNotLinked before findOrCreateBank.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic: the query and error live only in assertBankAccountNotLinked (accounts/app.ts).

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts is the single definition, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
